3.2.3.1.13 BswMWdgMRequestPartitionReset
Signature:
void BswM_WdgM_RequestPartitionReset(
ApplicationType Application
)
Deﬁnition:
request BswMWdgMRequestPartitionReset WdgM_RequestResetPart1
{
processing IMMEDIATE
initialValue WDGM_PARTITION_RESET_NOTREQUESTED
source
{Reference to [EcucPartition]}
}
Note:
This ModeRequestSource has to be created once for each partition
for which a reset can be requested by the Watchdog Manager mod-
ule.
